name: zottman-curl-dumbbell
title: Zottman Curl: Dumbbell
primer: This is an advanced exercise where you turn the dumbbells up and out.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Start with your hands at your sides.
Curl your arms up with your palms facing up, then turn your wrists so your palms face down as the dumbbells reach your chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells with your palms facing down and turn them back at the bottom.
